title: Urgent Summon from the Crown Prince
next_chapter_hook: The Crown Prince gazed at Chen Ji with an ashen face, his voice low and hoarse: 'Father's condition is critical. The princes are restless. The Imperial Tutor needs me, and I need the Imperial Tutor.'

text.content: The character 'Pavilion' on the Jade Slip shimmered with an eerie glow under the candlelight. When Chen Ji probed it with his spiritual sense, he found the seven characters seemed to come alive, constantly shifting—'Chapter Seven Hundred, Tianji Pavilion Awaits.' A cold smile curved his lips. The owner of this Tianji Record Fragment certainly had great airs. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul on the first page trembled slightly, as if wanting to say something, yet forcibly held back. Chen Ji tucked the Jade Slip into his sleeve, having already made his calculations.

Su Qingyao's figure swept into the room like a startled swan, her plain white skirt stirring a gentle breeze. Her face was paler than usual, and her eyes carried a rare hint of anxiety. Chen Ji noticed a strand of disheveled hair at her temple, clearly from hurrying here. 'Someone from the Eastern Palace is here,' she whispered, 'The Crown Prince urgently summons you to enter the palace immediately.' Her gaze fell on the bulging Jade Slip at Chen Ji's sleeve, eyes glinting, 'What is that?'

Chen Ji answered with studied indifference. He rose, tidied his robes, and casually tucked the Jade Slip bearing 'Tianji Pavilion Awaits' into his storage bag, his movements fluid and seamless. Su Qingyao's eyes slightly narrowed, yet she did not press further. She knew this man carried far too many secrets—each time she approached the edge of truth, he would brush past it with nonchalance. But today's urgent summons from the Crown Prince came far too suddenly—something major was about to happen within the imperial court.

choice.prompt: Facing the Crown Prince's urgent summon, Chen Ji needed to decide how to respond to this sudden situation.

choices.text: Set out immediately, use the momentum to enter the game
choices.description: The Crown Prince's urgent summon is precisely an excellent opportunity to leverage momentum and enter the game. Using his identity as Crown Prince's Imperial Tutor to enter the palace and gain greater political leverage within the vortex.
choices.visible_cost: Expose one's whereabouts, potentially attracting attention from other forces
choices.visible_reward: Deepen the relationship with the Crown Prince, gaining more political intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Be drawn into the vortex center of the succession struggle

text.content: Chen Ji rose, straightened his attire, and said to Su Qingyao: 'Since Miss Su has come, why not accompany me?' Su Qingyao slightly furrowed her brow but did not refuse. The two walked side by side out of the Tianqing Sect gate. Chen Ji noticed the atmosphere on the streets was much more tense than usual—commoners hurried along their way, and occasionally swift horses galloped past, kicking up trails of dust.

choices.text: Make slight preparations, set up a hidden layout
choices.description: No need to reveal oneself hastily. First have Su Qingyao gather intelligence, quietly observe the movements of all parties before making a decision.
choices.visible_cost: May keep the Crown Prince waiting too long, appearing insufficiently respectful
choices.visible_reward: Acquire more intelligence, seize the initiative
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince may develop suspicions

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao slightly nodded, a hint of approval flickering in her eyes. Chen Ji produced a communication Jade Talisman, whispered a few words, and the talisman transformed into streaming light and vanished. Moments later, information arrived like snowflakes—border unrest, imperial capital under martial law, princely mansions brightly lit through the night... Chen Ji sorted through each piece of intelligence, a cold smile forming at the corner of his lips.

choices.text: Utilize the Tianji Record, foresee the crisis
choices.description: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate, peer into the future within three hours, preemptively knowing the dangers and opportunities to be encountered upon entering the palace.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial foresight information, prepare countermeasures in advance
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is precious, do not misuse it

text.content: Chen Ji quietly extended his divine sense into the Tianji Record Fragment. An enigmatic power instantly enveloped him. The scene before his eyes shifted—he saw the Crown Prince sitting on the dragon throne with a pallid face, a blurry figure watching from the shadows, and a sharp sword suspended above his head. He abruptly opened his eyes, fine beads of cold sweat already forming on his forehead. The power of the Tianji Record was rebounding, but the gains were equally substantial—at the very least, he now knew of three concealed lethal traps.

On the way to the palace, Chen Ji systematically organized the intelligence Su Qingyao had gathered in his mind. Enemy forces were gathering at the border, and the influence of the temporal rifts had begun to manifest—this was no coincidence, but rather something being pushed by someone behind the scenes. As for that driving force, the answer was screaming to be revealed: the Tianji Pavilion. Su Qingyao stood silently beside him, knowing Chen Ji was deep in thought, yet unaware that he had already made his calculations. This man's mind was as deep as an ancient well, its bottom forever invisible.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, there is something I must remind you.

text.content: Su Qingyao's voice broke the silence. Chen Ji glanced sideways, only to see her brow furrowed, her gaze carrying a rare gravity. She lowered her voice: 'The influence of the Tianji Pavilion... runs deeper than you can imagine. There are people of theirs by the Crown Prince's side.' Chen Ji's footsteps paused slightly, a cold light flickering in his eyes. This piece of intelligence was invaluable. He gazed at Su Qingyao, his eyes profound: 'How did you come by this?' Su Qingyao shook her head: 'I cannot say. But you must believe me.'

The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's robes fluttered gently in the morning wind as Chen Ji, having adjusted his attire, calmly stepped through the grand gates of the imperial palace. Along the way, guards and palace maids cast complex glances—some disdainful, some curious, some silently speculating about this young Grand Tutor's origins. He was oblivious to all of this, eyes observing the nose and mind centered, as if everything was under his control. Only he himself knew that at this moment, a precise calculation was underway in his heart—what did the Crown Prince need, what could he provide, and what chess pieces had the Tianji Pavilion laid in this grand game.

choice.prompt: After entering the palace, facing the Crown Prince's inquiries, Chen Ji needed to choose how to respond.

choices.text: Be honest and forthright, striving for trust
choices.description: Honestly report the connection between the border anomalies and the Tianji Pavilion, demonstrating sincerity and competence to deepen the trust relationship with the Crown Prince.
choices.visible_cost: Expose part of his intelligence sources to the Crown Prince
choices.visible_reward: Gain deeper trust and dependence from the Crown Prince
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince might interrogate about the source of the intelligence

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, deciding to reveal a portion of the truth. He bowed and said: 'Your Highness, the border disturbances are merely the surface. Your servant ventures to guess that the true heartland threat is an organization called the Tianji Pavilion.' The Crown Prince's eyes slightly narrowed, clearly not unfamiliar with this name. He said softly: 'So the Master is indeed well-informed.'

choices.text: Stop at the right point, maintaining mystery
choices.description: Only reveal partial information, letting the Crown Prince realize the existence of crisis without pursuing details, preserving the strategist's sense of mystery and initiative.
choices.visible_cost: The Crown Prince might feel he was holding something back
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information asymmetry, grasping the initiative in the game
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince might harbor suspicions

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, his expression serene: 'Your Highness, please do not be impatient. The border matter is merely a skin ailment. The true problem lies in... someone close to His Majesty who is not behaving properly.' He stopped at the right point, saying no more. A sharp light flashed in the Crown Prince's eyes, but he did not pursue the matter, merely gazing deeply at Chen Ji. The meaning in that gaze was clear—he knew Chen Ji was holding back, but at this time of need for talents, he could only temporarily set it aside.

The moment Chen Ji stepped into the main hall of the Eastern Palace, he immediately sensed the oppressive atmosphere. The殿内光线昏暗，几盏长明灯的火焰似乎都比平日黯淡了几分。太子端坐在上首，面色苍白如纸，眼下的青黑清晰可见。他看到陈机进来，疲惫的眼眸中终于闪过一丝光亮，急切地站起身来相迎。陈机注意到太子的手指在微微颤抖——这位储君，已被逼到了悬崖边缘。

Su Qingyao's voice rang outside the殿, the Crown Prince slightly nodded to indicate his consent. Chen Ji's heart stirred, yet his expression remained unchanged. He knew Su Qingyao's visit must carry important news. A moment later, Su Qingyao entered the殿, her gaze lingering on Chen Ji for an instant before presenting a secret memorial to the Crown Prince. The Crown Prince unfolded the memorial, his complexion dramatically changing: 'Xuanwu Sect... Heavenly Alliance... and people from the Tianji Pavilion?!' Chen Ji lowered his eyes, a cold smile forming in his heart—this game was more complex than he had imagined.

choice.prompt: The Crown Prince inquired about countermeasures, and Chen Ji needed to provide advice.

choices.text: Remain still and watch, observe the situation calmly
choices.description: Advise the Crown Prince to remain motionless, letting various forces consume each other first, seeking breakthrough opportunities in the chaos.
choices.visible_cost: Might miss the first opportunity, respond passively
choices.visible_reward: See through everyone's cards and avoid becoming a target
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince may be impatient to act

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his tone calm: 'Your Highness, now is the time to avoid rash actions. What the enemy wants is for us to lose our composure. Why not use stillness to control movement, and let them reveal their fox tails first.' The Crown Prince meditated for a long time before finally nodding slowly. In his gaze toward Chen Ji, there was a more complex meaning—this seemingly timid Grand Tutor actually had such deep scheming in his heart.

choices.text: Take the initiative to strike first
choices.description: Advise the Crown Prince to strike first and disrupt the enemy's plans before they complete their arrangements, demonstrating a strong hand.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, may alert the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Seize the initiative and intimidate the insignificant
choices.risk_hint: Failure will lead to utter destruction

dialogue.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, and a sharp gleam flickered in his eyes: 'Your Highness, instead of waiting for death, why not take the initiative to strike. This minister is willing to travel to the border for Your Highness, to see with his own eyes what cards those跳梁小丑 hold.' The Crown Prince's eyes blazed with brilliance, and he suddenly slammed the table and rose: 'Excellent! I always knew, Grand Tutor, you are my子房!' Su Qingyao watched Chen Ji quietly to the side, a hint of imperceptible worry flickering in her gaze.

choices.text: Secretly advance through Chen Cang, plan for the long term
choices.description: On the surface advise to remain motionless, but secretly arrange a deeper chess game, accumulating chips for the future decisive battle.
choices.visible_reward: Lay the groundwork for the future decisive battle

text.content: Chen Ji paced a few steps in the hall, his voice low yet clear: 'Your Highness appears motionless on the surface, but secretly you can arrange a deeper game. This minister is willing to plant a few pieces for Your Highness in the court. When the time is ripe, we can close the net.' The Crown Prince's eyes flashed with insight, nodding repeatedly. He suddenly realized that this young Grand Tutor was even more profound than he had imagined.

Just then, Chen Ji suddenly felt a faint yet tangible gaze fall upon him. That gaze was cold and profound, as if from the deepest abyss of the nine yin realms. He calmly swept his divine sense across the surroundings, yet discovered nothing. But that sensation of being watched followed him like a shadow. The Tianji Pavilion—they are watching. Su Qingyao seemed to sense something as well, her gaze briefly meeting Chen Ji's, the meaning self-evident between them. The two tacitly did not point it out, yet both sounded the alarm in their hearts.

Su Qingyao's secret words entered Chen Ji's ears, carrying a rare hint of worry. Chen Ji nodded slightly, acknowledging. He raised his head, meeting directly the Crown Prince's eyes filled with expectation and anxiety. This young heir, now standing at the crossroads of destiny—and he, Chen Ji, was precisely the key figure determining his fate. Just then, hurried footsteps sounded outside the hall, and a young eunuch stumbled in, throwing himself to the ground with a thud, his voice trembling: 'Your Highness—the Emperor—the Emperor summons Your Highness to the palace immediately!' The Crown Prince's face turned ashen white.

Chen Ji quietly watched the Crown Prince's frantic departing figure, his gaze profound as an abyss. He knew that jade slip inscribed with the character 'Pavilion' would probably soon come into play. The shadow of the Tianji Pavilion had already descended upon this imperial palace. And he, this chess piece, on their chessboard—what role was he playing? Chen Ji lowered his head to look at his palm, where the lingering warmth of the jade slip seemed to remain. Chapter Seven Hundred—this was the end of a chapter, and also a new beginning. A cold smile curled at his lips, and he turned to gaze at the gloomy sky outside the hall. The winds and clouds were changing, the chess game had opened, and he, Chen Ji, would never be content to be a piece in another's hands.
